Name: Happy Birthday - Mail Bug Fix (Unofficial)
Author: Jed0ne
Description:
[size=3]This mod fixes a bug where letters remain stuck in the mailbox when [b]Happy Birthday[/b][/size][size=3] is used together with certain other mods that add custom mail (e.g. Mail Services Mod, and reportedly others as well).[/size]

[size=3]With this patch, you can continue using the latest version of [b]Happy Birthday [/b]without downgrading the original mod.[/size]

[b][size=3]This is an [/size][size=4]unofficial bug-fix patch[/size][size=4].[/size][/b][size=3] If the original author releases an official fix for this issue in a future update, I recommend removing this patch.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Unzip the archive.[/size]
[size=3]2. Place the extracted folder into your Mods folder.[/size]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

[size=3]Original mod by [b]Omegasis (Happy Birthday).[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520[/url][/size]

Manifest.Name: HappyBirthdayMailFix
Manifest.Description: Prevents HappyBirthday's OnMenuChanged from hijacking letters that belong to other mods (e.g. Mail Service Mod), fixing the stuck-mail bug without downgrading.
